scope: Exact real feasibility of 37 independently rotated unit squares; not a global lower bound or an optimality proof.

theorems.Packing37.exists_packing_37: Unconditional existence of a real 37-unit-square packing at the stated rational side.
theorems.Packing37.closed_disjoint: For every distinct i,j and every real plane point p, p cannot belong to both closed squares.
theorems.Packing37.all_unit: All 37 rational direction vectors have squared norm exactly one.
theorems.Packing37.all_bounds: All 148 exact rational wall inequalities hold.
theorems.Packing37.all_strict_separated: Every one of the 666 unordered pairs has a strict rational separating-axis certificate.
theorems.PackingGeometry.square_point_distance_sq: The unit-square parameterization preserves Euclidean squared distances.

trust_review: No custom axioms, proof placeholders, native_decide, floating arithmetic, or external solver assertions enter the Lean proofs.
Python emits explicit rational constants and proof text; Lean norm_num checks all arithmetic and fin_cases proves exhaustive finite coverage.
Each square uses its own rational direction; the perpendicular direction is exactly (-uy,ux).
Container inclusion quantifies every real point of the closed parameterized square.
Generic weak SAT bridge proves nonintersection of coefficient-open interiors; the actual data additionally proves stronger nonintersection of entire closed squares.
No theorem states that every smaller container is impossible; formalized feasibility is solely an upper bound.
The original finer rational side in the source certificate is independently verified outside Lean; this Lean certificate uses only the displayed side.
